label: ladder rung 11: open-file king safety + master opening book (+100 Elo in 32-game gauntlet, score 0.641)
elo_note: Calibrated with 8 threads and 1000 ms time budget vs Stockfish 2800 (W-D-L 2-1-3, score 0.42). Reaches depth 13 and ~3.0M knps through bitboard pawn moves, L1 cellToSq/cellColor slider table lookups, and quiescence bitmask occupancy. Brought in line with champion_bot.json on 2026-09-17: the hand evaluation was dropped (+33 +/- 22 over 1000 games at 10 ms, SPRT settled better, and 18% more nodes per second) and improving switched on (+12 +/- 11 pooled over 4000 games). Both were measured on the bot champion, which shares this engine and network; this file differs only in book, threads and the kingsafety term, which hand_blend 0 makes inert. The network was retrained on 2026-09-18 on a deduplicated corpus: the five pools merged to 10,957,828 distinct positions, 4,797,515 exact duplicates dropped out of 15,755,343 read. It read +15 +/- 11 over 3,600 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.78. The same five pools with their duplicates kept read -19 +/- 20 and self-play positions alone -26 +/- 20, so the gain is the deduplication, not the extra rows.
